nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum

avis.texte: i use this for my acne and it is the bomb. its super gentle and a little goes a long way. i have pcos and i break out for anything and everything. i use this every night and within a few days my acne is so much better. pair it with oinole patches and its the bomb. i aslo recommend the brightning patches from panoxyl to help with hyperpigmentation.

I am able to use this product. It works well to diminish fine lines and wrinkles and improve overall skin texture. It is not drying and I've experienced no irritation. I do use at night and use sunscreen during the day. I will purchase again and highly recommend.
I've only been using this a few weeks now, but have very sensitive skin and it doesn't irritate my skin at all. Melts into the skin and doesn't have a strong scent! Love it!

I have been using another brand for sometime. I didn't feel like it did much, read the reviews on this and took a chance. I have pretty sensitive skin and this has done wonders! I highly recommend and make sure to use moisturizer after applying

This product works, that isn't the issue. The issue is that the interior bag inside of the bottle holds approximately 0.5 oz. 15ml. I know this because I measured. It is not 1oz of product. It is not 30ml of product. It physically impossible based on the capacity of the interior bag. I wish I was a lawyer right now. If someone who is a lawyer wants to sue them for false advertising: sign me up.

avis.titre: I never leave reviews but this stuff is amazing
avis.texte: I've been using it for about 6 months and it has been the only product to improve my hormonal acne. It also lessened the fine lines on my forehead and eye area! I was genuinely considering fillers but I don't think I need them anymore.

I was using the SkinMedica .25% which has a similar creamy texture to the Kiehl's. No matter how slowly I ramped up with it I still got scaly skin. I've used the Kiehl's every other day for two weeks and so far so good. I use a moisturizer on top of it at night. The Kiehl's slow release retinal seems to be working. Very pleased so far.

Have been using product for less than one month so we will see if I get the results I'm looking for. So far I have been happy with the product. Does not irritate my skin and plan to continue to use it to help with fine lines and my deeper forehead lines.

avis.titre: A Game-Changer: Kiehls Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum
avis.texte: As a skincare enthusiast, I've tried numerous products in search of the perfect skin glow. Let me tell you, this product is a game-changer in every sense. From the moment I added this miracle potion to my routine, my skin underwent a transformation I never imagined possible. Imagine glassy smoothness that rivals a freshly polished mirror – that's the radiance we're talking about here. But it's more than surface shine; this product works deep, addressing blemishes with precision. Those pesky spots? Consider them history. And don't get me started on unbalanced skin tone – it's like this product has a vendetta against discoloration. It certainly rejuvenated my skin. But the real magic is beneath the surface. My skin feels healthier, more resilient, like it's been given a new lease on life. It's like Kiehl's gift to me, a vision of beauty imparting the secrets of eternal youth. So yes, I'm hooked. Obsessed, even. I'd go to great lengths for another bottle. And let's give credit where it's due – Kiehl's is more than a skincare label; it's a beacon of hope in the beauty world. You'll achieve dreamy skin with their products. In conclusion, if you want legendary skincare, get Kiehl's Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptide. It's a must-have. Trust me, your future self will thank you. Bonus tip: Add the Clearly Corrective Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel Serum to your routine for even better results. My partner even noticed, exclaiming, "Wow, your skin look

Not a fan. Except for adding this to my skincare regime, nothing else has changed and I've broken out into small, itchy, red bumps all over my face and the side of neck. I reached out to Kiehls via email but yet to hear back.

avis.titre: Fantastic daily treatment!! Softest skin ever!!
avis.texte: This daily serum is fantastic! My skin is so soft! So happy that I've begun to use it. I use it on my clean dry face after toning and follow it up with my daytime moisturizer. You use it only once a day. My skin is incredibly soft and facial lines are becoming less prominent. Can't say enough good things about this daily retinol treatment, as well as Kiehl's hyaluronic acid serum and Glycolic acid serum. Kiehl's products are so impressive.

avis.titre: The best Retinol I ever used.
avis.texte: This retinol was the best for me. I have tried other brands, but this one works for my skin. Most people said Kiehls is pricey, but for me, it is worth it. This retinol was not harsh to my face, and I can use it every night. I would say that I found the best skincare for me.
my skin after just a few weeks has noticably improved. this is amazing!

This is my first time using any form of retinol because I was always nervous with my sensitive skin. This is the perfect micro dose formula!! My skin honestly thanks me since I've started to use this. I'm about three weeks into using this retinol. I currently use this morning and night every other day as I am introducing it into my routine & didn't want to shock my skin and I am about to start using it daily next week! The holy grail combo for saving my skin right now is the combination of using the Pore Cleansing Mask & this retinol. In just a few weeks I have already started to see improvement in my red and uneven skin.
It's ok but the "one pump" isn't really sufficient for the face and the neck.

When I tell you that you won't be dissatisfied please believe me, this product is amazing! I've been using it for a month and I ended up buying 2 extra so keep handy. I will definitely keep buying it.
I've been looking for a good retinol cream and this one is probably the best I've tried.
I've been using retinoids for over a year now and wanted to try something different, the soy bean oil is terrible for acne prone skin. I have bumps all over my forehead now, such a waste of money.

I began with this retinol, and moved on to the stronger variation by Dr.Kiehls. I ended up coming back to this product. It keeps my acne cleared up almost completely. My skin has not been this clear in about 10 years (when a certain medication caused breakouts that continued after discontinuing those meds). I get one or two pimples at a time now if even. I never get painful zits now like I did before this product. My skin is very sensitive. I can only introduce one product at a time. My skin is more dry and never oily. I prefer this retinol because it is more moisturizing and my skin glows. The stronger retinol by Kiehls smells funky and did not reduce my 11 lines as promised. My deepset forhead wrinkles have not gone away with either, but maybe a small redux. Im 27 and my wrinkles are not that bad, but they exist. I think this retinol is better than their stronger one for me. I stay with this retinol because it clears my skin, keeps it moisturized, and looks like it plumpens my skin abd possibly reduced the appearance of wrinkles when paired with my cream and hyalornic acid.

If you have acne prone/sensitive skin this is a perfect product for you. I've struggled with using retinols in the past and had to stop because they broke me out so bad. But this product left me with a viable smoother complexion. 10/10 product and really recommend if you have had a bad experience w/ other retinol treatments in the past.

My first time using retinol, I was a bit nervous but after one week I'm already starting to notice a small difference in my skin and it's not as drying as I thought it'd be. I'm working on my wrinkles and can't wait to see my results after 1 month.
The texture of this serum is amazing. It's silky and buttery yet thin and soaks right into the skin. The cell turnover aspect really helps with acne scars and large pores!

avis.titre: Just 2 weeks in but loving this.
avis.texte: I adopted an 6 products to do daily/nightly as a skin care routine, and so far everyone I work with has said how much younger, healthier and glowy my skin looks. Love this!

This product works well for me. It improve my skin. My skin is a little sensitive, but this product didn't cause trouble for me. However, if your skin is more sensitive, you should be more careful. This product make my wrinkle on my face more shallow. I recommend using it as least for three month, then you can see a great result.
This is my first retinol and I love how gentle it is and easy to use!

avis.titre: You will not regret this purchase!!
avis.texte: The best thing Ive ever used on my face. Its so gentle unlike other retinol and the results are like magic. Ive never had skin so smooth and so CLEAR!! Saw results after 2 weeks of using and I will be re-purchasing this for life! Worth EVERY PENNY!

I was given the free sample of this microdose retinol together with the corrective cream. And I just fell in love! My skin improved visibly! Used together, they made my skin feel so hydrated and smooth and I loved the consistency of the corrective cream soooo much--it is so buttery--that I purchased this duo for my husband. And now he is in love too!

avis.titre: A retinol that doesnt break me out
avis.texte: I love how although this has retinol in it it is a product that has not damaged or broked my skin out and when i use it it leaves a glow and def have noticed my pores have minimized! I think this is perfect for those who are looking to start retinol

This Retinol serum is life-changing! I have always wanted to own a retinol serum because I use the tanning bed. Kiehls has made finding the best retinol easy! My skin no longer burns the way that it used to. It is so refreshed and hydrated daily. I have encouraged many of my friends to purchase this Serum. They also have noticed the change in my skin!
Love how gentle this product is on my skin! I can use it daily without issue

Kiehl's Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptide is a powerful, anti-aging youth serum containing a variety of anti-aging ingredients including Retinol, Ceramides and Peptides which are all wrapped up into one formula and come packaged inside of an easy to use / disperse bottle. This unique blend of ingredients is great for simply hydrating or moisturizing your skin but if you're looking for something extra to help combat aging and keep your skin looking younger, radiant and more youthful then this is definitely your go to serum! The texture is super light-weight, absorbs quickly into your skin and doesn't leave behind any kind-of stickiness or residue like some of the other serums I've tried which just leave your skin looking shiny or feeling greasy. The only reason I decided to give this product 4 stars instead of 5 is because I don't think I've been using it for long enough yet to actually see the full effects or notice any of the long-term benefits but so far so good and I'm very excited to see some more results!
My skin looks amazing!! My skin is glowing and looks so plumped! I'm obsessed with the results!! My fine lines are disappearing!!

The only thing I splurge on. I'm 27 and started using this to reduce eye wrinkles and prevent signs of aging. I use it every morning. Because the retinol tends to tighten pores, I've had way less acne since using it!
I love how this serum makes my face feel; nice & hydrated! I like that it's pretty lightweight & doesn't leave my face greasy! The texture of my skin has been improving! I can't wait to keep using!

avis.titre: When skin does not look so good, go to Kiehls
avis.texte: At 79 I have been lucky with my skin. Since moving to NYC 40 years ago, I have depended on Kiels products to keep my skin looking good at all ages. This new product came along just a I needed it.

avis.titre: This works, and it's one of my go-to serums
avis.texte: A wonderful, easy-to-apply serum that seems to really make a difference on my laugh lines and the fine lines above my brow!
Great foundation to my daily moisturizer. Light and just creamy enough to cover the entire face.
I did receive this item free - Super easy to apply, I can see a slight difference after a few weeks, prices, a factor, would buy
I use this serum every single night And it makes my skin look so beautiful I love the feeling and my skin looks beautiful I will buy again and again

I used this product two a three days a week at night time and the result I been see is my skin looks more even and soft help me with some scars and some o my fine lines looks more soft I know the retinol take time to see the result I can't wait to see the result when I finish the bottle

I love the texture of the serum. It glides on smoothly and it left my skin with a natural glow. My face look and feels clean, my tones are even. It doesn't leave my face feeling greasy. I love the packaging, one pump was enough to cover my face and under my chin.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I used this product once daily for several weeks. I immediately noticed a much smoother skin tone. After the first week, I began to notice an improvement with some of my fine lines. After two weeks I noticed an overall improvement with my skins appearance and texture. I would most definitely recommend this product to both friends and family.

avis.titre: I will be buying this and using it everyday!!
avis.texte: In just the short time that I have had this product and used it I see noticeable improvement in the look and feel of my skin. Not to mention that my face just feels better 😌

This serum has helped my skin look more youthful and softened my wrinkles. My skin is so soft and glowy. This serum was also gentle on my sensitive skin. I will be keeping this in my skin care routine!

I would recommend using in your regular routine and make sure you are using sunscreen! I love that Kiehls feels gentle and the packaging/bottle is luxurious. I felt my skin looked better after using but I was worried to go in the sun after.

I've used this 3 weeks every night. I started with large pores and pigmentation and some texture. I did notice smaller pores and some smoothness. I will keep using and hopefully see a difference in pigmentation and texture.

I don't recommend this for someone that's new to using retinoid on their skin regimen. But, if you want to try, do the sandwich method with hydrating moisturizers. Otherwise, this is a nice product to tackle fine lines.

avis.titre: Brighter skin within the first month!
avis.texte: A little goes a long way with this product. One of the best things about this product is while it gives nice results, the price is very fair and you get a lot of use out of the bottle. I live in Chicago where it's extremely windy and cold. I've noticed that since I've been using this product my skin has been looking brighter and more moisturized compared to before I started using the product. Definitely one to recommend!
I used this nightly under my moisturizer and I really like the way it made my skin feel. Make sure to use SPF everyday! It made my skin feel refreshed and made my skin clearer.

avis.titre: Need to use a bit longer
avis.texte: I liked it, but I think I need to use it longer to get a true idea of what it can do.

I am obsessed with this micro dose anti aging retinol serum with ceramides and peptide! Not only does it leave my skin so smooth and soft but it also reduces fine lines and wrinkles. My skin looks and feels like it is clear and brightened. I get compliments all the time about my skin glowing. This serum is so easy to use and works so well with my skincare routine. I highly recommend this product! It is so worth a try!

For years I've been self-conscious about deep wrinkle lines across my forehead. They're genetic and I've had them since my twenties. After 2 weeks of use, this product has significantly reduced the appearance of these lines. My girlfriend recently commented that I have "no wrinkles" -which at 38 is not true- but I was struck at the compliment after worrying about these lines for so many years. I would recommend!

I've been using this serum for a month and I've seen a great difference in my skin. As someone who's had experience with chemical peels and bakuchiol in the past, this is the first time I'm actually trying retinol and I would have to agree on the hype. I can definitely see the difference in my skin from months prior to now. I'm gonna be adding this to my favorites to repurchase.

I haven't used it long enough to see a difference, but I am happy with the product so far. I've only seen issues with retinol sensitivity after exfoliating my face, but otherwise it's been fine for my sensitive skin.

This is a great serum. I have noticed a change with my fine lines, I would definitely use with the Clearly Corrective Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel. This product is gentle enough to use everyday without irritating your skin. I would recommend this to family or friends.
I've been using this for 2 weeks now and I love it. It doesn't irritate my skin and I've seen a definite improvement so far. I was worried because I have sensitive skin but this has been great.

Thank you Keihl's for this gifting me this new product to try. As an acid/ retinol user with older skin, I am always on the hunt for the best. First off, I love the pump- quality packaging. The pump makes it easy to get the right amount of product. I enjoyed how it went on, not too thick so it could blend in easily. I liked how my skin felt just after application and for days after use. Softer, more elasticity kinda glowy. I am looking forward to even more noticeable improvements to my skin over time.

I was scared about using this product because some of the reviews said it burns and makes skin peel. I don't have overly sensitive skin but I have to be careful with some products. I've been using this once a day mostly except the days I forget and I haven't noticed any redness, burning, or peeling . I haven't noticed much difference at all in my skin. It feels fine going on and doesn't smell and seems like a little goes a long way, I'm just not seeing very much change in my skin. Maybe I haven't used this long enough to see the difference.

Love this product. During the winter months my skin gets super dry from using tretinion so this is great to incorporate into my routine. My skin feels super soft and hydrated the next day after using it at night. I would use it every night but I'm acne prone so I like to keep tretinion into my cycle so my skin doesn't go through anything purging stage.

Prescription grade retinol is too strong on my skin and can make me dry and flakey. I had since given up using this ingredient even through everyone always raves about its skin positive benefits. I was nearly going to give up on the stuff until my sensitive friend recommended this product. I gave it a chance and it been after a few weeks I've not had one reaction. In fact my husband just commented on how glowly my skin looks and this was the latest thing I've added to my routine. I love this product because it also includes ceramides and peptides - other buzzy ingredients I've been wanting to try because of their anti-aging properties.

I've been using this for a few weeks now and I'm really starting to see a difference in my skin. It feels so much more plump and smooth! I also feel like I notice a bit of a glow to my skin, I've really been liking it!

I've been using this product 3 times a week for a few weeks now, and I love the improvement I'm seeing on my skin. It's been smoothing out my skin texture, helping it improve, reducing the appearance of fine lines and my pores, and it feels like it firms my skin. In the mornings, when I wake up, I feel my skin looking and feeling better. I highly recommend this product in your nighttime routine.
I have sensitive skin and this retinol has been very gentle on my skin. I've been using this for about 3 weeks and my skin has been very soft.
My skin got incredibly red and developed a rash after trying this and I stopped using it
I put the crème on as part of my evening routine. My skin feels smooth and soft and more youthful in the morning. I will definitely keep it in my routine.
Creamy. Soft. Not irritating. Not greasy. Fragrance free. Leaves skin feeling smooth and light.

avis.titre: I'm ordering my next bottle NOW
avis.texte: I love how this product feels and how it makes my skin look. It leaves my skin soft and glowing without feeling greasy. I use it on my face neck décolleté and even my hands. I can admit it's time to start paying more attention to those areas.

I received this product to use along with Clearly Corrective™ Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel and all I can say is WOW!! There was an instant difference in my skin the next morning. I've faithfully used it since receipt and will definitely repurchase. Since I've used them together I can't really say how the retinol works alone. Together, they're a POWERHOUSE!
My skin has been looking so clear mositurized and smooth after using this product.

I received this sample from Kiehl's for my honest review. I've only been using this micro dose retinol for about 3 weeks, but I am already able to see improvements in texture. The cream is so gentle, I was able to use it daily without redness or irritation! From the first application, I noticed how soft it made my skin. It was like I had applied moisturizer. There's also no weird smell and it is a great consistency, not too thick or watery. I'll have to use it longer to see the effects on my line lines, but I could notice a difference in pore size and texture within a few days. I love how it doesn't dry out my skin or cause irritation- no need to "build up" to daily use.

avis.titre: Really great stuff- will buy again.
avis.texte: This is a great retinol containing product that was not too strong for my skin. In fact it was very hydrating with the added ceramides. No flaking or irritation. After 3.5 weeks I have noticed an improvement in the fine lines on my forehead (I'm 45) and maybe even slight improvement in firmness. Kiehl's gifted this product for me to review in exchange for my honest opinion. And I'm being truly honest when I say I will continue to make this part of my nightly routine.

This is my first review for a product purchased at Ulta and I'm a beauty junkie but this Kiehl's product might be the best retinol product I've ever used. I have (had) a super dark sunspot on my face that I'd been trying everything (except prescription products) to lighten up for a couple of years. We're talking the super expensive acid serums, red-light therapy masks and wands etc. - i was actually considering a chemical peel when I dug out a deluxe sample of this I got from some "free with purchase" gift and decided to try it. I notice within a week of use that it seemed like the dark spot was getting lighter. After just one week! I got lucky with timing and purchased the full size bottle during the ulta semi-annual sale just a couple weeks ago. I've been using this for probably close to a month now and my dark spot is disappearing. YAY! I use it every night and even put a little extra on my spot and really massage it in. The price point, even not on sale, is decent and you only need like a pea size of the product for each application, so it'll last. If you're on the fence, give this a try if nothing else seems to be working!

I really love using this at night because that's when I dedicate myself to my skin care routine, it's easy to apply and the best thing is that it doesn't irritate or dry out my skin, in the morning I notice my skin is smoother and it also calms pimples. inflamed. I loved it and recommend it to everyone.

First time using this product. I purchased it during the 21 days sale. My skin looks brighter and so smooth I'm 50 years old. I have I noticed a difference in the texture of my skin and the overall look of it . I recommend this retinol . I will be purchasing again.
I applied this every day to my face, neck and hands. Yes, hands! It was a smooth formula. It absorbed quickly without any stickiness. My face feels more hydrated and even.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I use this product every afternoon or night and I promise after using it it do bring back your features and it really do makes a difference if you have discoloration in your face

I liked this product very well. It did not irritate my skin, although my skin tolerates retinol fairly well, so ymmv. I felt that after using, my skin improved in terms of softening fine lines and making the pores on my nose less prominent.

avis.titre: I see the improvement on my skin
avis.texte: I use Retinol Skin Renewing Daily Mirco-Dose Serum daily. Sometimes in the morning or at night depending on my routine. I have notice a difference with me using the serum constantly. I like how it leaves my skin feeling hydrated and fresh. My skin has improved in it texture and appearance. The serum absorbs so quickly onto my skin as well as being easy to apply on my face, neck and hands evenly. It leaves not residue behind or skin irritation.
I liked this product, the scent was good and made my skin feel nice. I think I need to use more to see results, so I will keep using! A little pricey as well.

This serum is truly remarkable! While I found it a tad heavy for morning use, it has become a staple in my nightly routine. Immediately after washing my face, it banished the dry, tight sensation I often experience. I'm thoroughly impressed with Kiehl's Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptide. Teaming it with Kiehl's Clearly Corrective™ Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel has elevated my skincare regimen significantly. There's no scent and no adverse skin reactions, plus it's lightweight and non-greasy. I've noticed a remarkable improvement in the texture of my skin, particularly on my forehead. Despite initial concerns about sensitivity with retinols, this one has proven to be exceptionally gentle. I'm eager to witness the long-term results of continued use.

First off I did receive this product free for a trial sample and review. This Micro Dose Anti Aging Retinol Serium is a okay product. I used a tiny amount at the end of my fingers on a clean face. It really dried my lower face out around my mouth so I took a break there and moisturized well to fix it. Even though this is a low dose you need to be careful. ( I am not new to retinol, so not sure why this dried me out as fast as it did I have stronger ones) Did not see a real difference in my face with this product.

avis.titre: I would and will be buying this product again
avis.texte: As someone who is always on the hunt for effective anti-aging skincare products, I was excited to try out Kiehl's Retinol Skin-Renewing Daily Micro-Dose Serum. After using this product consistently for a few weeks , I'm happy to report that it has exceeded my expectations in almost every way. First off, the texture of this serum is amazing. It's lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling soft and hydrated. I appreciate that it doesn't leave any sticky or greasy residue. In terms of effectiveness, I've noticed a significant improvement in the overall appearance and texture of my skin. The retinol has helped to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, while the niacinamide and squalane have left my skin looking brighter and more radiant. I've also noticed a reduction in the size of my pores, which is a huge plus. What I love most about this serum is that it's gentle enough to use on a daily basis. I've tried other retinol products in the past that left my skin red and irritated, but that hasn't been the case with Kiehl's. I do experience some mild peeling and dryness, but it's nothing that can't be easily managed with a good moisturizer. The dropper is precise and easy to use, and the bottle itself is a beautiful addition to any skincare routine. It's definitely on the pricier side, but I feel that the quality of the ingredients and the effectiveness of the product justify the cost. The only downside to this product is that it's not suitable for sensitive
I'm not very familiar with retinol but this cleared up my skin. I would purchase and recommend highly.

I received Kiehl's potent retinol serum complimentary from BzzAgent and Kiehl's in exchange for my honest review. I've been a little scared of retinol even though I know it's time to start using it. This serum is a great way to ease into the benefits of a retinol! It mixes a daily strength retinol with Ceramides and Peptide to promote gentle skin turnover. I have rosacea and this has not caused any additional redness or itchiness which I appreciate. I used this in conjunction with the triple acid peel and I'm excited to see the benefits. Highly recommend

Thank you so much to Kiehl's Since 1851 for providing this free Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum in exchange for an honest review! As a 40 year old construction worker, my skin care routine was pretty much non-existent. I was nervous at first because this was my first time using retinol but I didn't have any adverse reaction to it whatsoever. My pores look smaller and my skin feels smoother. After using this product for about a month, I can definitely say this will become a staple for me!

avis.titre: A good option for night retinol
avis.texte: I receive this product for free and exchange for my honest review. I have used it ~10 times in the past 4 weeks and have liked the results. My skin looks clear and fresh after using it. The only downside I've noticed is that if I don't wash it off first thing in the morning, my skin will react with even a small amount of sunlight (even with a layer of SPF). This is not a product I personally would use for daytime, though the packing states that it can be used during the day. I'm not sure if my skin is more sensitive to retinol+sun than the average person.

avis.titre: This is everything you wanted in one product!
avis.texte: I got this product as part of a campaign for my honest review from bzzagent. I want to start off by mentioning how gentle and effective this is! Retinol gets the skin cells to turn over faster and the ceramides and peptides help make the newer layer more resilient and healthy! This is why I mentioned that it does everything! If you are looking for the fountain of youth this is the closest thing that comes to mind in terms of products I've tried. What I love about this is the ease of use and how it shortens your skin care routine without sacrificing any actives. Definitely a staple product with science backed evidence!

avis.titre: My skin looks smoother and brighter
avis.texte: I want to start by saying that I never had any irritation whatsoever from this product, and I started using it nightly at the same time I was using the Triple Acid Peel in the morning. I like the vacuum pump for dispensing product, though I don't feel one pump is enough for your full face and two was too much, and didn't care for the opaque bottle making it impossible to know when to re-up before I run out. Within a week my skin was smoother, less dull, and looked better under makeup. I will say there was a short purging period, but if you stick with it, this product really does the job. I purchase more of this in a heartbeat and I recommend it to someone seeking out a good retinol product.

I have not had great experiences with retinol in the past. I have dry sensitive skin. This product seems to be giving me results without excessive side effects. I am noticing a slight reduction in fine lines. The dryness is minimal. I will continue using.

I've been using the micro-dose anti-aging retinol serum with ceramides and peptides for one months now, and I'm impressed. The lightweight texture absorbs quickly, and I've noticed a visible reduction in fine lines and improved skin texture. It's gentle on my sensitive skin, and the packaging is convenient. Overall, a great addition to my skincare routine. Highly recommend!

I use this retinol at night time. After clean before moisturizer. It's micro-dose combine with peptide and Ceramides, it will hydrate your skin really good. The good thing of this retinol is not thinner my skin or irritation.
I love today night! I woke up to amazing skin. I'm so excited to keep using this.

I am a huge fan of this retinol serum! As someone with sensitive skin I am not always able to use retinol products but this one is gentle and I use it daily! I love the way my skin texture feels. Definitely worth a try!
I suffer from sensitive dry skin. My skin has never felt so good after using a product for such a short amount of time!

Started using this product only at nighttime since I was using a different product for the morning. And when I say this product did wonders it did! I would wake up feeling super hydrated on my face. I have wrinkles on my forehead and under eyes and this honestly made them not stand out as much. It gets rid of harsh lines. It is better to start out once a day because it has retinol and most people purge or breakout from it. I had no issues however and would recommend trying this product. I currently like to keep it to a nighttime routine but I imagine using twice a day would make even more of a difference. Make sure you're using sunscreen when you go out if using it during the daytime because it can dry your skin out from the sun.

I have been loving Kiehl's Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptide. I have been using it along with Kiehl's Clearly Corrective™ Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel. This combo has been a great addition to my skincare routine. No smell and no skin reactions with this product. Lightweight not greasy. I feel like my texture on my skin especially my forehead has greatly improved since using this product. It is not harsh, sometimes with retinols you think your skin is going to be so sensitive, but this one has been super gentle. I can't wait to see the results after using for longterm.

avis.titre: Nice gentle retinol to start out with
avis.texte: I have combo to oily sensitive skin, with clogged pores being an issue. I've used prescription tretinoin but found it to be too rough for my skin. This does produce a feeling of smoother skin, but without the redness the next day. No pimples from this product either.
I received this product for review purposes. I applied this product to my face after washing it and it leaves my skin nice and hydrated. Helped with my skin tone and cleared up my blemishes.

Thanks Kiehl's for my free product. I have used this product for the last week in conjunction with the peel. I have used retinols in the past that aggravated my skin, but this product did not do that. I tend to have sensitivity around my nose when I introduce retinol into my routine and this product was very gentle even in delicate areas. I also really liked the pump on this product for my medicine cabinet.

This serum is absolutely amazing! I did find it a bit heavy for morning use but loved it and will continue to use it as part of my night routine. It made an immediate difference in how my face felt after washing. (I tend to get that dry tight feeling) This got rid of the tightness feeling right away. Thank you Kiehl's for sending me this product free in exchange for my honest review!

avis.titre: Adding to my skin care routine
avis.texte: As a 50 year old who always had good skin when younger, the aging process is showing more texture and fine lines on my face. I started using the Kiehl's Retinol Skin-Renewing Daily Micro-Dose Serum and my face seems firmer, with fewer fine lines and smoother texture. I will be adding this to my routine for sure and I would recommend this to my friends as well. I feel like my skin looks younger and that's awesome.

After cleansing my face I put half a dropper of Clearly Corrective™ Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel onto cotton pad and apply to face. I wait for it to dry and then follow with kiehls Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptides, followed by my moisturizer. I love the way it leaves my skin feeling and looking. I feel as though my skin looks rejuvenated and radiant! I received both products in exchange for a review and I'm so glad to have received them! I have already repurchased them (as they were on sale). I intend to use this for a long time.

I received this product for free in exchange for a review. I absolutely love this! I did notice a small amount of dryness and peeling initially, but I switched to applying it every 2-3 nights instead of every night and the dryness has gone away. My skin is looking and feeling firmer and my under eye wrinkles are less noticeable. An added bonus is that it's paraben and fragrance-free. I can't wait to see long term results!

I received this and the clearly corrective triple acid peel serum and have been using both daily for a few weeks. They work great in combination. Usually, I wouldn't be able to use a peel and retinol daily without drying out my skin but this is a very gentle combination. It's too soon to tell if my there are any affects on my fine lines and hyperpigmentation yet.

avis.titre: Yes I am getting this again
avis.texte: I use it every night of dry face. I haven't seen the biggest change in my skin but my face is definitely more hydrated and even looking skin stone in morning
Good retinol product. I can see the difference in my skin in about a week. Not irritating.

avis.titre: Start slow if your skin is sensitive
avis.texte: My skin is a little sensitive. If you do, you migh want to use tjis once a day or every other day and increase slowly over time. I have been using the Clearly Corrective Daily Re-Texturizing Triple Acid Peel and the Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptide twice a day. I appreciate these free sample. After about a week and a half my skin seemed a bit smoother and I had not had any irritation. After a couple more days, my skin became irritated. After a little break, I plan to just use one in the morning and the other at night and skip using either once a week. I am hopeful that with longer term use I will see more results since the active ingredients have been shown effective in skin care.

This is the first retinol product I have used that has been non irritating to my sensitive skin. It is creamy, moisturizing and very light scent. A dab will do as a little goes a long way. I have used other Kiehl's products over the years and certainly trust this brand.

I have been using this everyday for a few weeks and people have noticed my skin is glowing. Its reduced the loon of my pores and leaves my skin moisturizer all day long. I use it right after I wash my face in the morning.

If you are look to try a anti-aging retinol serum this ceramides peptide from Kiel's is a must. Very lightweight and oil free when applied to my skin. Definitely can see the changes it make; run and grab this serum and add it to your skincare routine.

avis.titre: A new must have in my skincare routine
avis.texte: Thank you #bzzagent #kiehls I was so glad that I received this to try for free. You truly only need one pump to cover your entire face and your neck. It also has ceramides and peptides which are also very good for your skin. I typically use this one at night but I have used it during the day too. If you're going to use it during the day, make sure you wear sunscreen! The packaging is great and easy to use. This has been perfect for my sensitive skin. There's something about it being a micro dose that my skin just takes to. Over the past 3 weeks I have noticed that my fine lines have greatly diminished and my skin is glowing. I did have purging but it didn't last long and it didn't inflame my face. The price point is excellent. I plan to add this to my skincare routine.
I love the way it feels. It is luxurious on the skin. I feel the improvement on my skin after a couple weeks of use.

I received a free sample of Kiehl's Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptide from BzzAgent to try and review. I began getting fine lines and wrinkles on my face in my 30's due to sun damage, stress and living in an area with a lot of pollutants in the air. Sometimes when I look in the mirror now, at the age of 53, I feel my appearance is that of a much older woman. I have spent thousands of dollars on products through the years that made little or no difference in the appearance of my skin at all. Ive been using this product for 3 weeks and I'm actually starting to see a change in the overall appearance of my skin. My skin feels smoother and softer. I can see my fine lines staring to smooth out and the deeper wrinkles are not as pronounced as they were before. I feel much more confident when I look in the mirror now.
Thanks BzzAgent for sending me this product to try and review! I have been using this for some time and like how it's not as strong or stripping as traditional retinol. My skin texture is improving

avis.titre: i would buy this product again!
avis.texte: this product is so great!! it has such a smooth feel, and is so dewy and glowy!

avis.titre: High Quality Ingrediants For A Fair Price
avis.texte: Kiehl's does it again with a great value priced serum with powerful ingrediants that other brands charge much more for. This works wonders under the eyes too! Love all the new peptides as well!

When I started using this product, I was having some break-outs. Within two days, my break-outs were clearing up. Oddly, my skin felt more oily, yet more balanced than it had before. Perhaps the ceramides in this serum provided the moisture that my skin was needing! I'm hoping to see some anti-aging benefits, as well, but it's too soon to tell. In the meantime, I really love how it feels when applying - creamy and smooth. I put it on at night and wake up dewy!

avis.titre: Did Not For Work For Me!
avis.texte: Started using Kiehls ultra moisturizer when nothing else was working to hydrate my aging melinated skin. I have tried some of their other products including this one and I find that it's either a hit or a miss. This product was a miss, dried my skin out, even under the ultra moisturizer. Caused my skin to itch and breakout which is symptomatic of my skins reaction to dryness. I stopped using it.

avis.titre: this one is my new go to!
avis.texte: I've been looking for the perfect retinol for my skin and this one is it! Light weight, fast absorbing and doesn't dry my skin! I use every other night on a freshly washed face and apply a thick moisturizer on top! I've recently received many compliments on my skin!!

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This product is amazing. In a short time, it has already made a huge difference. My skin is dewier and more even toned. I naturally have very dry skin and it has helped so much. Highly recommend!!

I have used this brand a few times in the past. Usually, samples that didn't wow me. I am using this in conjunction with the triple acid smoothing peel (which I do in fact like a lot). I recently ran out of my retin a prescription and this retinol has now taken its place. I use it before bed (skipping a day or two every now and again) after I wash & tone my face. It's not greasy and doesn't have a noticeable scent.
